_comment: HARD bounds the auto-tuner may never cross. For each tunable parameter: min, max, and max_step_per_day (the biggest change allowed in a single evening). The tuner reads this file but NEVER writes it. Parameters NOT listed here (daily_loss_stop_usd, max_position_pct, pdt_equity_floor_usd, max_trades_per_day, daily_deploy_cap_usd's ceiling, per_trade_max_usd's ceiling) are off-limits to the tuner. Note: 'max' values here also respect the absolute code-level caps, so the tuner can only ever make the inviolable limits SAFER, never looser.
